name: H3 Storyboard → Sequential Beats

provenance.adaptation: Media Lab-owned normalized template, safety gates, variables, and QA contract; no source media, character artwork, dialogue, or attached prompts copied

evidence_summary: A storyboard reference can give MiniMax H3 sequential shot guidance without repeating every scene description in the text prompt, provided the prompt explicitly says each panel is a separate beat and the storyboard is not one static image.

defaults.panel_order: left-to-right, then top-to-bottom unless panels are numbered

storyboard_reference.description: One storyboard/contact-sheet image carried as an H3 Ref2VA reference—not image_start and not a first frame

character_reference.description: A separate QA-passed single-subject character image; never concatenate it into the storyboard

panel_order.default: Follow numbered panels; if unnumbered, read left-to-right and then top-to-bottom.

performance_or_dialogue.default: Natural restrained performance across the depicted actions; no exaggerated expression or movement.

continuity_lock.default: Preserve the exact character identity, age, face, hair, body proportions, wardrobe, recurring objects, set geography, lighting direction and color palette across every beat.

camera_rule.default: Use each panel's framing and camera intent; transitions are clean cuts or physically plausible short moves, never a morph between panel layouts.

audio_rule.default: When supplied, preserve the exact approved audio timing and synchronize visible speech/action without rewriting dialogue.

character.role: Character: exact identity, age and continuity

reference_transport.fail_closed: If H3 Ref2VA is not resident, or either required reference is absent or undecodable, do not fall back to FL2VA, LTX, text-only, or a grey canvas.

prompt_template: Use {{storyboard_reference}} as sequential shot guidance, not as a static image. Do not treat the storyboard as one image and do not reproduce panel borders, gutters, labels, or the complete board in any frame. {{panel_order}} Follow each panel as a separate chronological beat. Use {{character_reference}} only as the exact character identity reference. {{continuity_lock}} {{camera_rule}} {{performance_or_dialogue}} {{audio_rule}} The storyboard already defines the scene content, framing and action, so do not invent additional scenes or redundantly reinterpret every panel. End on the final storyboard beat as a clean stable shot.

forbidden: animating the complete storyboard sheet as one frame
split-screen output unless a panel explicitly requests it

before_render: Verify storyboard and character are two separate references.
Verify storyboard is not assigned to image_start/image_end.
Verify H3 Ref2VA is resident and the canonical GPU lock is held.
Pin the seed and preserve the full-resolution storyboard source.
after_render: Compare each chronological beat with the corresponding storyboard panel.
Check identity, age, wardrobe, recurring objects, camera and set continuity.
Reject any frame showing the board, panel gutters, duplicates or grey canvas.
For dialogue, inspect lip timing and preserve the approved audio master.
Retain A/B evidence and never mark final before Steve approves.
